name: Workplace: co-working
about: A flexible workspace let by the desk and by the room: hot desks and dedicated desks in the open, private team offices of several sizes, a community cafe at the front, an event space, many phone booths. In three parts: the Workplace: co-working typology (on the Workplace one), an office fit-out on an RCC shell, and the BuilderPluss standards with the Indian codes. 2.1.0: its walls, fences, railings, parapets, beams, doors and windows in the versions that say how they sit and meet (R156: justify, corner, priority, align), all as before until one is set.
